newsitem.title: SPAIN: Spain holds door open to send force to Albania.
newsitem.headline: Spain holds door open to send force to Albania.

text.p: Spain said on Thursday it would contribute to a military force to help restore order in Albania if it had the support of other European nations.
Spanish officials made the offer in response to Albanian President Sali Berisha and political parties who called on Thursday for NATO's European members to provide military assistance to Tirana.

"If all the Albanian parties in the conflict ask for it, Spain will not object," a Foreign Ministry spokesman told Reuters. "But Spain will not go it alone, it needs the support other European nations."
Spain's Foreign Minister Abel Matutes said European foreign ministers would discuss sending a force to Albania at a scheduled meeting on Saturday in the Netherlands.
